_comment: Registry of source channels behind each video group. 'source_type' = how the group's video list is defined: 'channel_scrape' (yt-dlp scrape, cached under channel_cache/), 'curated' (hand-picked subset of a channel, hardcoded in transcribe.py VIDEO_GROUPS), or 'fixed' (standalone video/webinar, no parent channel). 'status' fields were last verified on 'last_checked'; regenerate with the check-new-videos flow.

channels.name: Alexander – Fuldt Booket
channels.notes: Curated subset of the channel; the older testimonial/case clips (17 counted on 2026-09-20, 18 listed on 2026-09-22, 17 again on 2026-09-24) are deliberately excluded (one of them, flMsd1NCtyA, is no longer playable). Solo monologues: the 13 pre-2026-07-29 videos are intentionally not diarized; everything transcribed since then is.

channels.name: Workshops (Vimeo)
channels.notes: Two standalone Vimeo workshop recordings. No parent channel to track.

channels.name: Marketingpod med Halfdan Timm og Kristian Tinho
channels.notes: Full-channel scrape cached under channel_cache/. Complete: every tracked video is transcribed and diarized; 299 of 339 have real speaker names (known speakers + aliases in channel/speakers.json) (hosts are labelled Halfdan / Kristian; Kristian Tinho was spelled "Christian" until 2026-09-20), the other 40 stay letter-labelled for lack of evidence (mostly solo clips, or one letter covering both hosts). The channel listing also carries 1 Short, which the scraper filters out (340 listed -> 339 tracked). One episode (TVexnIlT-ps) was retitled upstream after transcription; transcribe.py now dedups by video id so it is not redone.

channels.name: Obsidian Content Masterclass (webinar)
channels.notes: Single Obsidian webinar. Diarized + named (Olivia, Kasper, Morten, Andreas).

channels.name: 2Marketing customer statements
channels.notes: Four customer testimonial videos hosted as direct MP4s on 2marketing.nu (wp-content/uploads), pulled in by yt-dlp's generic extractor rather than a site extractor. No parent channel, so there is nothing to re-scrape: new statements must be added to VIDEO_GROUPS by hand. Each is a ~1 min solo piece to camera, so diarization returns a single speaker A; the speaker's first name is in the title for three of the four.
